stemMd: If the earlier opinion expressly declined to rely on inexperience, a later judge who made inexperience the sole basis of the precedent would

options.label: A
options.textMd: necessarily preserve the most faithful reading.

options.label: B
options.textMd: be performing only a clerical task.

options.label: C
options.textMd: need to confront a substantial inconsistency with the earlier court's stated reasons.

options.label: D
options.textMd: show that all precedent has no force.

options.label: E
options.textMd: be required to ignore all other decisions.

explanationMd: The third paragraph gives precisely this limiting example. Facts present in a case are not automatically the reasons for its outcome; an express disclaimer constrains later claims about its governing principle.

distractorRationale.d: One strained description does not eliminate every constraint.
distractorRationale.e: Other cases can help assess the description.
distractorRationale.a: The passage calls that description difficult to defend.
